main_text.l: Schabek imperium Kunkam in VI. regna divisit.

Hic Schabek circa A. C. 1500 potentissimum Imperium in India condidit, ejusque majorem partem ditione complexus fuit, dictus alio nomine S. ha-Holam, i. e. Rex Mundi. Hujus Imperium in VI. regna divisum fuit, quorum
1. Decan, cujus reges communiter appellantur Imad-Maluco, i. e. columna regni; pro quo Lusitani vitiosè pronunciant Madre-Maluco.
2. Amdenager, cujus reges vocantur Nisa-Maluco, i. e. regni hasta.
3. Braganadar. Cujus reges vocantur Cotteb Maluco, i. e. vertex regni.

page.notes: Marginal mark "1." at the top right, beside the heading. Left margin shows only the facing page's edge, not transcribed. "4. Pro-" stands at the foot as the printed start of item 4; it is not a catchword, since it is a numbered list item. The word after "divi-" is partly unclear and is read as "sum" [?]; the printed form may be "fum". The heading "KUNKAM" is printed "KUN-" / "KAM." across two lines.
